plans.idea: Classic left-to-right banner read: brand lockup, then the three bottles as one lineup (hero plus the two secondary bottles beside it), then the headline block, ending on the Build Your Pack / Online Only badges as the action at the right edge.

Message-first: the headline copy anchors the left half, then the bottle trio sits in the middle, and the badges and a small logo sign off on the right, so the strip opens with the words and closes on brand.

Product-led: the bottles open on the left, a wide center column carries the headline and flavors, and a right-hand end cap stacks the Solstice lockup above the badges, the way the original puts the brand over the call to action.
